summary: Churchill Capital Corp XIII, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO on August 3, 2026. It sold 41.4 million units (including over-allotment) at $10.00 per unit, generating $414 million gross proceeds, plus a private placement of 350,000 units to Churchill Sponsor XIII LLC for $3.5 million. $414 million ($10.00 per unit) was deposited into a U.S.-based trust account with Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company, trustee. Each unit consists of one Class A share and one-tenth of a warrant exercisable at $11.50. The audited balance sheet is included as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for the target acquisition announcement within the typical SPAC two-year completion window, with redemption/risk-arb dynamics at deal announcement.
